layout_dets.text: ABSTRACT

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: PITTARD, JAMEs (School of Microbiology, University of Melbourne, Victoria,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Australia), AND B. J. WALLACE. Distribution and function of genes concerned

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: with aromatic biosynthesis in Escherichia coli. J. Bacteriol. 91:1494–1508. 1966.—A

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: number of mutant strains of Escherichia coli K-12, which are blocked in the bio-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: synthesis of the aromatic amino acids, were examined biochemically to determine

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: their particular enzymatic deficiencies. The mutations carried by these strains

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: were mapped by use of the methods of conjugation and transduction. Structural

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: genes for five of the enzymes of the common pathway leading to chorismate and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: for the two enzymes converting chorismate to phenylpyruvate and p-hydroxy-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: phenylpyruvate, respectively, were identified. Unlike the genes of the tryptophan

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: operon, most of these genes are distributed over widely separated regions of the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: chromosome.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The various enzymatic reactions by means of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: which the bacterium Escherichia coli converts

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: erythrose-4-phosphate and phosphoenolpyruvate

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to chorismate are now well established (13, 25).

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Chorismate is a key intermediate in aromatic

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: biosynthesis, because it is the last intermediate in

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the common pathway and, as such, can be con-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: verted enzymatically via a number of different

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pathways into the end products tyrosine, phenyl-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: alanine, tryptophan, ubiquinone, vitamin K, and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: folic acid (5, 6, 10, 11).

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Mutant strains blocked in any of the reactions

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: leading to chorismate show a multiple require-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ment for two or more of the aromatic amino

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: acids and vitamins depending on the complete-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ness of the block. Such mutants have been re-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ferred to as multiple aromatic auxotrophs as dis-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tinct from strains blocked in any of the specific

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pathways leading from chorismate to tryptophan,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: phenylalanine, or tyrosine, these latter strains

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: being known as tryptophan auxotrophs or phenyl-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: alanine auxotrophs, etc.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Very little is known about the distribution on

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the E. coli chromosome of the structural genes for

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: each of the enzymes involved in the reactions of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the common pathway. The mutations carried by

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: some aromatic mutants have been mapped (24),

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: but, since no biochemical investigations were

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: carried out, the functions of the mapped genes

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: were unknown. It is the purpose of this communi-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cation to describe the chromosomal location and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the specific function of five of the aro genes con-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cerned with the common pathway and of one of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the phe and one of the tyr genes concerned with

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the phenylalanine and tyrosine pathways, re-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: spectively. (For a description of symbols used, see

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Table 1.) Some of these mutant strains have been

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: obtained from A. L. Taylor, some from R.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Somerville, and the rest have been isolated in

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: these laboratories.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: To locate the genes on the chromosome, we

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: have used both interrupted mating techniques

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and phage P1kc-mediated transductions (this

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: phage will subsequently be referred to as P1).

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The data from interrupted mating experiments

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: make it possible to assign to a gene a definite

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: chromosomal location, and this method has been

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: used in the construction of most chromosomal

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: maps. The accuracy of the method, however, does

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: not make it possible to distinguish genes that are

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: separated by less than 1 to 2% of the E. coli

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: genome. Since the E. coli chromosome may con-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tain as many as 5,000 genes, mutations separated

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: by less than 50 genes may not be separable by

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: this method.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Phage P1 is unable to cotransduce two chromo-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: somal markers that are separated by more than

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: approximately 2% of the E. coli genome. When

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: two markers are cotransducible, however, an esti-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mation of the distance between them can be made

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: by measuring the frequency with which they are

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: separated by recombination events. This may be

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: measured by use of a wild-type donor with a re-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cipient that carries both mutant alleles, in which

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: AROMATIC BIOSYNTHESIS IN E. COLI

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: case the frequency at which the wild-type alleles

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: are cotransduced will vary inversely with the dis-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tance that separates them. This distance may also

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: be measured if one mutation is present in the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: donor strain and the other in the recipient. In this

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: case, the frequency with which wild-type trans-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ductants are obtained will vary directly with the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: distance that separates the two mutations. In

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: general, transduction studies involving P22-Sal-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: monella typhimurium systems and P1-E. coli sys-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tems indicate that, if two mutations occur in a

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: single gene, then the frequency with which wild-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: type transductants are obtained in crosses be-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tween mutants will vary between about 5 and 0%

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of that obtained with wild-type donor phage, de-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pending on the relative positions of the mutations

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: within the gene (15, 21, 28).

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: In some cases in this work, where preliminary

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: conjugation experiments indicated that a number

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of different mutants constituted a single geno-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: type, only one or two members of the group were

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: examined in interrupted mating experiments, and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the group identity of the remainder was verified

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: by transduction tests. In those cases where we

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: have carried out time of entry experiments on

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mutant strains already mapped by Taylor and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Thoman (24), our results do not differ signifi-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cantly from theirs.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: We have retained the genotype symbols used by

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Taylor and Thoman (24), except in two cases, in

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: which we found that mutations to which they have

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: given separate gene designations could be shown

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to be located within a single gene. These findings

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: have raised certain problems with regard to no-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: menclature, which we propose to deal with as

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: follows. In the case of mutations which Taylor

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and Thoman (24) have listed as occurring in two

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: genes, aro-C and aro-B, and which we found to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: occur within a single gene, we have made the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: following changes. For reasons to be discussed

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: later, we have retained the aro-C designation for

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: both mutations and used the aro-B designation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: for one of the aromatic genes which had not

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: previously been mapped. In the case of the two

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mutations which Taylor and Thoman (24) have

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: placed in the two genes phe-A and phe-B and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: which we found to occur within a single gene, we

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: have retained the phe-A designation for both

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mutations. Since we have not located any other

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: genes concerned with phenylalanine biosynthesis,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: phe-B does not occur on our map. The specific

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: reactions by means of which erythrose-4-phos-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: phate and phosphoenolpyruvate are converted to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: chorismate and then to phenylalanine and tyro-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sine are shown in Fig. 1. The genetic symbols

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: used to identify the structural genes for each of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: these enzymes are included in the figure.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: It is to be noted that the sequence of upper-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: case letters used to describe different structural

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: genes does not necessarily correspond to the se-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: quence of enzymatic steps. For example, aro A is

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: concerned with the enzyme carrying out the sixth

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: reaction of the common pathway and not the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: first.

layout_dets.text: Media and culture methods. The media and culture

layout_dets.text: AROMATIC BIOSYNTHESIS IN E. COLI

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Nutritional tests. A 0.1-ml amount of a light sus-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pension (approximately 10⁶ cells per milliliter) of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cells was added to a soft-agar layer and poured onto

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: a minimal-medium plate supplemented with all the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: amino acids required for growth, except the aromatic

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: amino acids. When the layer had set, a sterile filter-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: paper disc was placed on the surface of the plate, and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: one drop of a 1 mg/ml solution of the nutrient being

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tested was added to the disc. Plates were incubated

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: for 48 hr at 37 C, and the results were read.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Interruption of mating. Samples (1.0 ml) were

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: removed from the bottles at 2- to 5-min intervals

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and transferred to screw-capped tubes containing 1

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ml of bacteriophage T6 [approximately 101º plaque-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: forming units (PFU) per ml]. The cell-phage mixture

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: was immediately agitated in a Vortex Junior mixer

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: for 45 sec to disrupt mating pairs, and then incubated

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: at 37 C for 10 min to allow the phage to adsorb to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the T6-sensitive male parents. Phage T6 was used to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: kill the male parent in crosses involving the Hfr

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: strains AB313 and AB311. Any phage-resistant

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mutants of the male parent were unable to grow on

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the selective medium which lacked amino acids

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: necessary for their growth. When the streptomycin-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sensitive Hfr strain AB259 was used, however, the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.text: Transduction techniques. Transduction techniques

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: used in this work have been described (19).

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Syntrophism tests. The method described by Gibson

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and Jones (12) was used.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Adelberg and Meyers (3) was used. In most cases,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ultraviolet light was the mutagenic agent, but, in

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: dine. When the latter mutagen was used, the proce-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: dure described by Adelberg, Mandel, and Chen (2)

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: was followed.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Preparation of cell-free extracts. Cells harvested

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: from 18-hr cultures were washed with chilled 0.9%

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: NaCl and then suspended in 4 ml per 1 g (wet weight)

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of either 0.1 M Tris (pH 7.8) or 0.1 M phosphate

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: buffer (pH 7.6). Cell breakage was achieved by forcing

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cells through a French press at a pressure of 20,000 psi.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Cell-free extracts were obtained after centrifugation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: at 21,600 × g for 20 min, and were stored at

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Column chromatography of enzymes. This was

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: carried out by use of the method described by Cotton

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and Gibson (5).

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Assay of dehydroquinate (DHQ) synthetase. The

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: method described by Srinivasan and Sprinson (23)

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: was used.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Assay of dehydroquinase. The method described

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: by Mitsuhashi and Davis (17) was used. In these

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: assays, since no dehydroquinic acid was available,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the substrate for the reaction was the filtered super-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: natant fluid containing the accumulation products of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: E. coli 83-1 (see 26).

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Assay of dehydroshikimate (DHS) reductase. The

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: method described by Yaniv and Gilvarg (27) was

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: used. Cell-free extracts were assayed for their ability

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to convert shikimate to dehydroshikimate. Dehydro-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: shikimate formed was estimated by measuring optical

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: absorbance at 234 mu in a Unicam SP500 spectro-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: photometer.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Assay of shikimate kinase. The following incuba-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion mixture was used: shikimic acid, 2 μmoles;

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.text: μmoles; cell-free extract, 1 to 2 mg of protein; 0.05

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: M Veronal buffer (pH 9.0) to a total volume of 2.0 ml.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Kinase activity was determined by measuring the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: disappearance of shikimate according to the method

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of Gaitonde and Gordon (9).

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Estimation of shikimate-5-phosphate. This was

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: measured by conversion to shikimate with alkaline

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: phosphatase according to the method of Morgan,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Gibson, and Gibson (18).

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Assay of 3 - enolpyruvyl - shikimate - 5 - phosphate

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: (EPSP) synthetase and chorismate synthetase. Since

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: free extracts were examined for their ability to carry

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: out the overall conversion of shikimate to anthranilate.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The general conditions used for this assay have al-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: readily available, and all the strains being examined

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: were tested for their ability to convert shikimate to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: shikimate-5-phosphate. Anthranilate was measured

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of the chorismate formed from shikimate can be con-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tracts from cells in which anthranilate synthetase

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: was derepressed. This was achieved by growing cells

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: in a minimal medium containing excess tyrosine and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: phenylalanine (2 × 10-4 M), p-aminobenzoic and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: p-hydroxybenzoic acids (2 × 10-6 M), and limiting

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: indole at a concentration of 1.5 × 10-5 M.

layout_dets.text: Complementation tests. Cell-free extracts unable to

layout_dets.text: carry out the overall conversion of shikimate to an-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: thranilate were mixed in various combinations and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tested for their ability to complement each other in

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the overall reaction. As a result of these tests, cell-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: free extracts could be directed into two groups

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: (groups I and II), significant conversion of shikimate

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: to anthranilate only being observed when extracts

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: from both groups were present.

layout_dets.text: Identification of enzyme activities present in cell-free

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: extracts of groups I and II. To establish which enzy-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: matic activities were missing from extracts of groups

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: I and II, complementation tests were carried out in

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: which different extracts were added sequentially. In

layout_dets.text: these tests, 0.2 ml of a cell-free extract from one

layout_dets.text: group was added to the reaction mixture and incu-

layout_dets.text: bated at 37 C for 40 min. The incubation mixture was

layout_dets.text: then heated at 100 C for 5 min and then cooled to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 37 C (step 1). Then 0.2 ml of an extract from the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: other group was added, and the reaction mixture was

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: again incubated at 37 C for 40 min (step 2). The

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: anthranilate formed was measured as described for

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: anthranilate synthetase. Anthranilate will only be

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: formed when the extract added first is able to convert

layout_dets.text: shikimate to EPSP (i.e., possessing full activity for

layout_dets.text: EPSP synthetase), and when the extract added last

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: possesses full activity for chorismate synthetase.

layout_dets.text: ADDENDUM IN PROOF

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: We have recently isolated a mutant strain which,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: although able to grow on minimal media alone, has a

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: strict requirement for tyrosine in the presence of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: phenylalanine and tryptophan. Either dehydroquinic

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: acid or shikimic acid can replace tyrosine as a growth

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: factor. It is probable that this mutant has lost the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tyrosine sensitive isoenzyme which converts erythrose-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and phosphoenolpyruvate to PKDH.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: This new gene, for which we propose the designa-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion aro-F, is cotransducible with the phe A gene at a

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: frequency of 50% and with the tyr À gene at a fre-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: quency of 60%. Hence, two genes controlling two of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the first specific reactions after the branch point and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: one of the genes involved in the first specific reaction

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of the common pathway are situated very close to-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: gether on the chromosome. The significance of this

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: arrangement for the regulation of this pathway is

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: currently under investigation.
